procedure: - Preserve the simulation-only, non-clinical, no-real-device boundary and the visible `SIMULATION ONLY — NOT FOR CLINICAL USE` banner.
- Current product schema is `PROJECT_SCHEMA_VERSION` `3.0.0` (`SimulationProjectV3`); keep V1/V2 migration paths working in persistence.

- Arm topology may be paper-informed; all cart dimensions, link geometry, joint axes/limits, IK parameters, and motion-sweep defaults remain configurable illustrative proxy data — never manufacturer measurements or proprietary CAD.
- Node.js 24 (`HUGO_RAS/.nvmrc`); use `npm ci` with the committed lockfile.

1. Work from `HUGO_RAS/`. Keep domain schemas in `src/domain/`, presets in `src/presets/`, pure analysis in `src/geometry/` (`analyze`, `docking`, `kinematics`, `physicalModel`, primitives/transforms), persistence/export in `src/persistence
2. Preserve metres/radians internally and centimetres/degrees at the UI boundary; keep +X patient-left, +Y head, +Z upward.
3. Treat launch (`StartScreen`), wizard (`SetupWizard`), and expert workspace as distinct app views; do not collapse custom-setup staging into silent defaults.

4. Keep docking collision-aware and deterministic: approach sectors, cart paths, Ready/blocker reporting, and sequential docking order belong in `geometry/docking` + `physicalModel`, not ad-hoc UI math.
5. Keep FK/IK, RCM constraints, capsule clearances, triangulation, and motion envelopes unit-tested; keep heavy solves out of React render paths and select the narrowest Zustand slices.
6. When changing persistence, library keys, exports, or project contracts, extend unit tests (`docking`, `kinematics`, `project`, `store`, `geometry`, `App`) and Playwright e2e coverage together.
7. Do not add CT/DICOM, cloud auth, real HID/robot protocols, proprietary geometry reverse-engineering, or clinical decision language.
8. When dependencies or workflows change, update `HUGO_RAS/README.md`, `HUGO_RAS/AGENTS.md`, `HUGO_RAS/skills.md`, this section, and both root and `HUGO_RAS/.cursor/skills/` mirrors together.
